changelog:
**The configuration page now supports German and English.** The selected language applies across navigation, channel settings and the content preview and is saved with the plugin configuration.

**Collection previews keep Jellyfin's saved order.** They no longer sort collection titles alphabetically.

**Trailer previews stay away from the immediately following programme.**
description: Lightweight virtual TV channels: deterministic schedules over your own library, tuned in via normal direct playback at the live position. No transcoding, no tuner emulation.
name: LiteTV Channels
overview: TV channels from your library, without transcoding.
